package.name: floe-opencl-clvk-runtime
package.description: Private OpenCL 3.0 ICD runtime over the Floe Venus Vulkan GPU with an externally supplied verified clspv

sourcePhase.note: Only public metadata, small pinned header copies, patches, text/AST/shell/apply, synthetic ELF manifest checks and package-contract checks were performed. No CLVK/clspv build, ICD load, kernel build or GPU result is claimed.

predecessor.note: Read-only source package. This package adds the runtime-only profile, external compiler admission and runtime package gate; it does not modify predecessor bytes.

builds: OpenCL (genuine CLVK ICD) and required SPIRV-Tools
external-runtime.compiler: external ARM64 Linux clspv process supplied and verified at package/admission time
external-runtime.optionalCapabilities: SPIR-V IL and cl_khr_il_program are absent unless --enable-spirv-il and a verified external llvm-spirv are supplied

external-runtime-il.requires: verified external clspv plus verified external llvm-spirv
external-runtime-il.note: Separate optional profile. Not the default component build.

full-original.requires: LLVM, clspv, SPIRV-LLVM-Translator, host tablegen and libclc as pinned by the predecessor
full-original.note: External mode defaults OFF; the original full profile remains exactly the predecessor's build path.

clvk.sourceDir: externally supplied clean checkout at the pinned commit

clspv-header.role: Only external/clspv/include/clspv/Sampler.h is needed by clvk's offline compiler path; it contains sampler/reflection constants and no LLVM dependency.

spirv-headers.role: SPIR-V grammar/headers used by CLVK and SPIRV-Tools

spirv-tools.role: SPIR-V parsing/validation/linking required by the genuine CLVK ICD; not an LLVM component

llvm.role: External clspv compiler provenance only; NOT a runtime build input in external-runtime profile
llvm.downloadPolicy: not downloaded or built by this source package

spirv-llvm-translator.role: Only the external llvm-spirv executable in the optional external-runtime-il profile; NOT built or linked by the runtime

ocl-icd.role: Debian 13 OpenCL ICD loader dependency; not replaced by this package

loaderFacts.icdFileContent: first line is a filesystem path passed to dlopen

vulkan.role: System Vulkan loader/headers; the matched private Venus ICD is selected by VK_DRIVER_FILES

libclc.note: The pinned clspv build embeds its libclc bitcode. If a future compiler build needs external libclc resources, the manifest must list and hash every file and packaging must verify them.

limitations: Structural ELF checks plus a declared provenance manifest prove ABI and immutable bytes, not the origin of a binary.
The manifest is an owner-supplied attestation; the validator never executes the compiler on the source host.
A malicious-but-structurally-valid compiler that lies in its manifest is outside this static validator's threat model.

privatePatches.purpose: Rename only the shared ICD target to libfloe_clvk (SONAME libfloe_clvk.so.1) so ocl-icd can dlopen it without colliding with the system libOpenCL.so.1 loader.
privatePatches.behaviorChange: None in the exported OpenCL API; library basename/SONAME only.

privatePatches.purpose: Add CLVK_EXTERNAL_CLSPV. In external mode the top-level project does not add_subdirectory(clspv) or SPIRV-LLVM-Translator, does not set LLVM/toolchain projects, and the OpenCL target only sees the pinned clspv public header plus the configured external executable paths.
privatePatches.behaviorChange: None when CLVK_EXTERNAL_CLSPV=OFF (full original profile). In external mode compiler support stays ON and the offline clspv process path is preserved.

privatePatches.purpose: Make CL_DEVICE_COMPILER_AVAILABLE reflect whether the configured offline clspv executable is actually executable, instead of compile-time support alone.
privatePatches.behaviorChange: Only reduces a false compiler-available claim when the external executable is missing or not executable; clBuildProgram then returns CL_COMPILER_NOT_AVAILABLE.

privatePatches.purpose: When CLVK_ENABLE_SPIRV_IL is OFF, clCreateProgramWithIL/clCreateProgramWithILKHR return CL_INVALID_OPERATION instead of creating a program that can never be built; the extension and IL device info remain absent.
privatePatches.behaviorChange: Only in the explicitly IL-disabled external-runtime profile; the full and external-runtime-il profiles are unchanged.

toolchain.sysroot: externally supplied Debian trixie arm64 sysroot
toolchain.knownCompiler: Apple clang 21.0.0 --target=aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu + -fuse-ld=lld (declared, not run for CLVK)
toolchain.note: No ARM64 CMake configure, compile or link is performed in this source phase. The producer fails closed on any missing pinned input and never downloads.
